model_annotation: Figure 4 is a horizontal bar chart illustrating the number of participants who found each evaluation criterion beneficial when assessing a developed tool. The vertical axis is labeled "Number of Participants" and ranges from 0 to 6 with a scale interval of 1, while the horizontal axis lists the evaluation criteria. The bars are grouped into stacked segments representing different aspects of the criteria, including the main criterion and its sub-components, with each segment colored differently according to the legend on the right side of the chart. The chart shows that "Relevant FCs" is considered the most beneficial, with six participants highlighting it, followed by "Relevance Explanation" and "Clarity and Simplicity" with four and three participants, respectively. The chart is not sorted in any particular order, and the bars are labeled with their corresponding values. Overall, the chart effectively conveys the relative importance of each evaluation criterion as perceived by the participants.
